options.name: api_host
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the pfSense device.

options.name: api_key
options.description: An API key to use for authentication.

options.name: api_password
options.description: The password to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: api_port
options.description: The port number of the pfSense API.

options.name: api_protocol
options.description: The protocol to use when connecting to the pfSense API.

options.name: api_username
options.description: The username to authenticate with the pfSense API.

options.name: cache_enable
options.description: Enables the EAP-TLS session resumption / fast reauthentication cache.

options.name: cache_lifetime
options.description: Lifetime of cached entries (in hours).

options.name: cache_max_entries
options.description: The maximum number of entries in the EAP-TLS cache. Set to 0 for infinite.

options.name: cisco_accounting_username_bug
options.description: Enables the workaround for the CISCO AP1230B firmware 12.2(13)JA1 accounting username bug.

options.name: default_eap_type
options.description: The default EAP type invoked when an EAP-Identity response is received.

options.name: disable_weak_eap_types
options.description: Disables weak EAP types (MD5 and GTC). When enabled, only stronger EAP types like TLS, TTLS, PEAP, and MSCHAPv2 are allowed.

options.name: ignore_unknown_eap_types
options.description: If enabled, unknown EAP types are ignored instead of rejected. A proxy module must be configured to forward such requests to another RADIUS server.

options.name: max_sessions
options.description: Helps prevent DoS attacks by limiting the number of EAP sessions the server tracks.

options.name: ocsp_enable
options.description: Enables OCSP support for EAP-TLS client certificate verification.

options.name: ocsp_override_cert_url
options.description: When enabled, the configured OCSP responder URL overrides the URL extracted from the client certificate.

options.name: ocsp_url
options.description: The OCSP responder URL used to verify EAP-TLS client certificates when OCSP is enabled.

options.name: peap_copy_request_to_tunnel
options.description: When enabled, attributes available outside of the EAP-PEAP tunnel are copied into the tunneled authentication request.

options.name: peap_default_eap_type
options.description: The default EAP type used inside the EAP-PEAP tunnel.

options.name: peap_soh_enable
options.description: Enable or disable Microsoft Statement of Health (SoH) support inside EAP-PEAP. The SoH site configuration must be edited at /usr/local/etc/raddb/sites-available/soh outside of this API.

options.name: peap_use_tunneled_reply
options.description: When enabled, reply attributes from the tunneled authentication are returned to the NAS.

options.name: ssl_ca_cert
options.description: The Certificate Authority (refid) used by the FreeRADIUS EAP module. Leave unset to have the FreeRADIUS package auto-generate a temporary CA on apply.

options.name: ssl_ca_crl
options.description: The Certificate Revocation List (refid) checked when verifying EAP client certificates. Leave unset to disable CRL checking.

options.name: ssl_server_cert
options.description: The server Certificate (refid) presented by the FreeRADIUS EAP module. Leave unset to have the FreeRADIUS package auto-generate a temporary server certificate on apply.

options.name: timer_expire
options.description: The expiration time (in seconds) of the EAP-Response / EAP-Request correlation list.

options.name: tls_ca_subject
options.description: The expected CA subject string for issuer validation. Leave blank to use the subject of the configured SSL CA Certificate.

options.name: tls_check_cert_cn
options.description: When enabled, the Common Name of the client certificate must match the User-Name attribute.

options.name: tls_check_cert_issuer
options.description: When enabled, the server/client certificate must match the configured CA issuer.

options.name: tls_fragment_size
options.description: The EAP-TLS fragment size (in bytes). Cannot exceed 4096.

options.name: tls_include_length
options.description: When enabled, the total length of the EAP-TLS message is included in every packet, instead of only the first packet of a fragment series.

options.name: tls_min_version
options.description: The minimum TLS version that will be accepted for EAP-TLS-derived methods.

options.name: ttls_copy_request_to_tunnel
options.description: When enabled, attributes available outside of the EAP-TTLS tunnel are copied into the tunneled authentication request.

options.name: ttls_default_eap_type
options.description: The default EAP type used inside the EAP-TTLS tunnel.

options.name: ttls_include_length
options.description: When enabled, the total length of the EAP-TTLS message is included in every packet, instead of only the first packet of a fragment series.

options.name: ttls_use_tunneled_reply
options.description: When enabled, reply attributes from the tunneled authentication are returned to the NAS.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the API.
